column1: # Per-file shard weights for the time-weighted CI shard map (SFN-863).
# weight = round(1e6 * max over targets of (file_elapsed / suite_total)).
# Target-neutral by construction: a share, not a duration, so the same
# table balances macos-arm64 and linux-arm64 despite a ~2.4x speed gap.
# Source: run 31817603043 (workflow_dispatch on main) JSONL sidecars,
# Targets contributing: linux-arm64(775 files) macos-arm64(775 files).
# linux-x86_64 writes no sidecar by design (action.yml:411-415).
# An unlisted file gets the median weight (280); a missing/unparseable
# table falls back to the alphabetical stride. Never fails a build.
